# NYU Agentic AI Workshop 2026

> The current workshop taught by Adi Singhal and Luca Chang.

Use this section for the 2026 curriculum, schedule, released slides, starter code and recordings. Do not substitute the 2025 archive for current course information.

- [Course in Markdown](https://adityasinghal.com/agentic-ai-workshop-2026.md): the complete published course page.
- [Course webpage](https://adityasinghal.com/agentic-ai-workshop-2026/): interactive recordings and current information.
- [Public course repository](https://github.com/adityaarunsinghal/agentic-ai-workshop-2026): released lessons and runnable examples.
- [Workshop data](https://adityasinghal.com/api/v1/workshops.json): structured course data and published resources.
- [2025 archive reading map](https://adityasinghal.com/agentic-ai-workshop-2025/llms.txt): the earlier course.
